name: Typhon
description: Typhon was the Witch of Pride who lived 400 years ago. Retaining the innocent demeanor of a young child, she judged everyone she met against an absolute balance of right and wrong, dismembering those she found guilty of sin. She met her demise drowning in a trap at the Watergate City of Priestella, and her soul was preserved by Echidna inside the Castle of Dreams.
